# The script and play lines that throw a failure's words or exit away with no
# `# ignored: <reason>`, one file:shape per row with why it is left
# (internal/ci/discarded_class_test.go, TestNoScriptHidesAFailure). Most are
# probes whose answer is the exit or a fallback with a second spelling; the
# reason names the lines that hide a failure the operator should see. fleet/ is
# being reworked (2026-09-30), so its rows wait for that. A row leaves when every
# line of its shape in its file is reasoned or fixed; it never comes back. This
# list only shrinks, and NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 drops a stale row and never adds one.
# A row is `file:shape <sites> <reason>`: <sites> is how many sites the row covers, and it
# only falls. A new site under a listed key (a discard with no `// ignored:`, a `|| true`,
# a `2>/dev/null`, a refusal with no remedy, an OK beside a failing exit) makes the
# count too low and the run red, and fixing a site makes the count too high and the
# run red until it is lowered (NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers it, and never raises one).
# ceiling: 7
fleet/roles/container-runtime/tasks/main.yml:stderr-null 1 the rootfs probe expects its write to fail and exits 15 if it lands; fleet/ is being reworked, so the reason comment waits for that
tools/bench-wsl2.ps1:stderr-null 6 six lines, each a probe whose empty answer the script reports (go version, id -un, systemctl is-active, tailscale ip, the ssh round trip) or an idempotent `id -u || useradd`
